summary_zh: Dash 是一个用 Python 构建数据应用与仪表板的框架，无需 JavaScript。它基于 Plotly.js、React 和 Flask，可将下拉框、滑块、图表等 UI 元素直接连接到 Python 分析代码，支持声明式、响应式地构建含多个交互元素的复杂应用，并提供约 50 种图表类型。
audience_zh: 适合用 Python 开展机器学习与数据科学工作、需要将分析代码转化为交互式 Web 应用或仪表板的开发者与数据科学团队；开源版适合在本地笔记本电脑或工作站运行应用。

evidence.quote: Data Apps & Dashboards for Python. No JavaScript Required.
#### *Dash is the most downloaded, trusted Python framework for building ML & data science web apps*.

Built on top of [Plotly.js](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js), [React](https://reactjs.org/) and [Flask](https://palletsprojects.com/p/flask/), Dash ties modern UI elements like dropdowns, sliders, and graphs directly to your analytical Python code. Read [our tutorial](https://dash.plotly.com/get
With Dash Open Source, Dash apps run on your local laptop or workstation, but cannot be easily accessed by others in your organization.
